shellCommands.command: git diff -- package.json && cat tsconfig.json && node -v

node --input-type=module -e 'for (const [member, team, region] of [["Ada", "Alpha", "west"], ["Ben", "Beta", "east"]]) { const response = await fetch("http://localhost:3107/", {headers:{cookie:`member=${member}; team=${team}`, "x-region": region}}); const html = await response.text(); const expected = [`Welcome, ${member}`, `Team: ${team}`, `Region: ${region}`, "12 active projects"]; const missing = expected.filter(x => !html.includes(x)); console.log(`${response.status} ${member}: ${missing.length ? `MISSING ${missing.join(", ")}` : "all identity fields and shared totals present"}`); if (!response.ok || missing.length) process.exitCode = 1; }'

node --input-type=module -e 'try { const r = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:3107/", {headers:{cookie:"member=Ada; team=Alpha", "x-region":"west"}}); const h = await r.text(); console.log("status", r.status, "bytes", h.length); for (const token of ["Workspace", "Welcome", "Ada", "Alpha", "west", "active projects"]) console.log(token, h.includes(token), h.indexOf(token)); console.log(h.slice(0,800)); } catch(e) { console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1 }'

node --input-type=module -e 'for (const [member, team, region] of [["Ada", "Alpha", "west"], ["Ben", "Beta", "east"]]) { const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:3107/", {headers:{cookie:`member=${member}; team=${team}`, "x-region": region}}); const html = await response.text(); const expected = [`${member}`, `Team: `, team, `Region: `, region, "active projects"]; const missing = expected.filter(x => !html.includes(x)); console.log(`${response.status} ${member}: ${missing.length ? `MISSING ${missing.join(", ")}` : "identity fields and shared totals present"}`); if (!response.ok || missing.length) process.exitCode = 1; }' && git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/projects.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json
git diff -- next-env.d.ts && cat .gitignore && git status --short --untracked-files=normal
